exposure: Acute kidney injury (AKI) e-alerts during pregnancy or postpartum
outcome: AKI recognition rate by obstetric team
cohort: Pregnant or postpartum women with AKI e-alerts for AKI Stages 1-3 (KDIGO criteria) at a tertiary centre
finding: While Pr-AKI e-alerts were identified in a significant proportion of pregnancies, only 41% were recognized by the obstetric team and a cause for Pr-AKI was not identified in many cases, suggesting the need for pregnancy-specific e-alert algorithms.
